title: Xanthe and the Glasshouse
author: Tamsin Winterbourne
blurb: Theo Eriksen, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
